title: in-toto Bundle line = a recognized Envelope (derived)
description: DERIVED - not verbatim. bundle.md 9.1 (rendering 876-885): 'Each line within a Bundle SHOULD be an Envelope. Consumers MUST ignore unrecognized lines.'
